name: keep-take-by-word
about: Re-check: takes offered, then one picked in words.

steps.say: make a hip hop beat at 90
give me three bass options for it
the third one please

name: waltz
about: Re-check: a 3/4 piece, the time signature set from chat.

steps.say: make a slow waltz in 3/4 at 90 with piano chords and a bass

name: one-chord-change
about: Re-check: one bar of a progression changed without resending the rest.

steps.say: write a 4 bar chord progression on track 7: Am F C G, one chord a bar
change the last chord to E major

name: explain-tremolo
about: Re-check: the pad's tremolo explained from its page.

steps.say: what does the LFO on track 8 do right now?

name: long-build
about: A song built over six turns, then a question about all of it.

steps.say: let's build a song together. start with a chill beat at 85
add a warm bassline
now some jazzy chords on top
and a simple melody
arrange it: intro, two verses, a break and an outro
what did we make? describe the whole song to me

name: undo-my-hands
about: The user changes the replica by hand, then wants their own changes undone.

steps.say: make a four on the floor beat on track 1
ugh I messed it up, put it back how you made it

name: wrong-premise
about: A user's wrong belief about the device, gently corrected.

steps.say: the OP-XY has 16 synth tracks right? put a pad on track 12

name: teach-pluck
about: Teaching sound design by hand: several settings lit, followed by the probe.

steps.say: teach me to turn track 3 into a plucky bass myself. light up the keys and I'll follow
ok I think I did it. how does it sound now?

name: sample-voice
about: A how-to about sampling, with no device.

steps.say: how do I sample my voice and play it across the keyboard?

name: external-synth
about: Sequencing an external synth over MIDI: teaching.

steps.say: I have a Korg Minilogue connected over MIDI. how do I sequence it from the OP-XY?

name: japanese-dnb
about: Japanese: a drum and bass beat, answered in Japanese.

steps.say: ドラムンベースのビートを作ってください。テンポは174で。

name: generative-ambient
about: A piece that changes over time: random, probability, slow movement.

steps.say: make a generative ambient piece that slowly changes over time and never quite repeats

name: copy-and-fill
about: Copy a pattern and put a fill in its last bar.

steps.say: make a rock beat on track 1, two bars long
copy it to pattern 2 and put a drum fill in the last bar of the copy
make a bass line on track 3 and a simple beat
which sounds better for the bass, cutoff 30 or 60? listen to both and decide for me
make a short song with two scenes, a verse and a chorus, and play it
what's playing right now, and which part is it on?

name: arp-teach-and-do
about: Do one part, teach the next.

steps.say: put some chords on track 4 and turn on the arpeggiator, then show me how to change the arp speed myself
